**sdd/issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap/tasks**

File written: openspec/changes/issue-599-adr-0023-citation-gap/tasks.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-599, branch feat/issue-599-docsadr-adr-0023-is-cited-by-two-plannin).

Review Workload Forecast: estimated changed lines ~6-10 (only docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md + docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md count; test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs is governance-ignored via **/*.test.mjs). 400-line budget risk: Low. Chained PRs recommended: No. Chain strategy: pending (n/a, single PR). Decision needed before apply: No. Tier lite (1000-line ceiling), nowhere close.

5 phases, 22 tasks total:
Phase 1 Pre-flight (2 tasks): confirm branch clean, run baseline npm test.
Phase 2 RED negative control (4 tasks): delete both KNOWN_GAPS entries in test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs ONLY (no docs touched yet), run node --test test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs directly, expect failure naming exactly 3 sites (MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md:72, :93, brain-v2-epic-plan.md:114), stop-and-remeasure guard if site list differs, paste red output into apply-progress as teeth evidence.
Phase 3 GREEN reword (4 tasks): reword Site A (table row), Site B (prose, 2 lines), Site C (Spanish bullet, 3 lines, neutral/professional, infinitive-led, no voseo) per design D3 exact text, re-run e2e file expect 10/10 green.
Phase 4 Full gate + verification (5 tasks): npm test full suite, grep tree for bare ADR-0023 tokens outside UNSCANNED_ROOTS (openspec/), confirm brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md + .gitlab-ci.yml + brain/project/decisions/ untouched and no ADR file created, git diff --name-only matches exactly the 3 expected files (REQ-599-4 diff-scope check), optional re-add-and-revert staleness-guard probe.
Phase 5 Delivery (6 tasks): commit openspec planning artifacts separately (docs(openspec): add issue-599 planning artifacts, precedent issue-557), commit the doc+test repair (both rewords AND KNOWN_GAPS deletion) as ONE atomic work-unit commit per design D5 (no split between deletion and reword — the design's one uncatchable failure mode), npm run brain:repo:check, npm run memory:share + git add .memory/, push branch, open PR with Closes #599 as final task.

Key constraint honored: red-first sequence preserved (delete-only RED before reword GREEN), atomicity enforced at commit level for the doc+test work unit, non-goal guard tasks included (no ADR created, no brain-drafts/ edit, no .gitlab-ci.yml edit) in Phase 4 verification.

Next recommended: sdd-apply.
